Grandmother's Buttermilk Biscuits

Ingredients
2 cups all-purpose flour
1 tablespoon baking powder
1 teaspoon salt
6 tablespoons cold butter
3/4 cup buttermilk

Method
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees.
2. Cut the butter into the flour, baking powder, and salt.
3. Stir in the buttermilk until just combined.
4. Pat out and cut, then bake for 12 minutes.
